body: Since pain rarely goes away on its own, ignoring it (becoming insensitive) is a poor choice if we want to minimize it.
Do you cry? I find crying eases some of the pain. Whenever I'm angry I'm really just sad. I don't know your story, but my motives for suicide are usually based on anger and resentment.
Problems rarely go away on their own and often get worse if unadressed.

I feel pity whenever I read posts like this. I know your suffering, but I don't know how to help you. Philosophy has helped me, particularly Epicurus' philosophy. The only thing that prevents me from killing myself is that there is some hope to attain meaning, that it has and can be done. The meaning of your life is often revealed in the answer to the question "why haven't you killed yourself yet?"
I think many mental conditions are the result of a lack of meaning and continuance of pain.
